overlay.liveText: Specification: Moment Diary Backend MVP (v2)This specification defines a backend-first MVP for "Moment Diary" using Bun, Hono, and SQLite. The goal is a clean, testable, and robust API that implements core diary management with authentication and timeline filtering.1. ScopeBackend API only: All endpoints return JSON.Authentication: Email/password registration and login with Bearer token session management.Diary Management: CRUD operations for diary entries with mood and tags.Timeline: Paginated and filtered view of diary entries.Data Persistence: SQLite database at data/moment-diary.db.Testing: Automated tests covering all core business rules and security requirements.2. Technical Stack & ConstraintsRuntime: BunLanguage: TypeScriptFramework: HonoDatabase: SQLite (via bun:sqlite)Authentication: Simple Bearer token (not JWT). Tokens are stored in a sessions table.Password Hashing: Bun.password (bcrypt/argon2).CORS: Not implemented.Migration: Auto-initialize schema on startup.3. Data Schema (SQLite)usersid: INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENTemail: TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULLpassword_hash: TEXT NOT NULLcreated_at: DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMPsessionstoken: TEXT PRIMARY KEYuser_id: INTEGER NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users(id)created_at: DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMPdiary_entriesid: INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENTuser_id: INTEGER NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users(id)title: TEXTcontent: TEXT NOT NULLmood: TEXTis_favorite: INTEGER DEFAULT 0 (boolean)created_at: DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMPupdated_at: DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMPtagsid: INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENTuser_id: INTEGER NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users(id)name: TEXT NOT NULL (original casing)normalized_name: TEXT NOT NULL (lowercase, for deduplication)UNIQUE(user_id, normalized_name)diary_tagsdiary_id: INTEGER NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(diary_id) REFERENCES diary_entries(id) ON DELETE CASCADEtag_id: INTEGER NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(tag_id) REFERENCES tags(id) ON DELETE CASCADEPRIMARY KEY(diary_id, tag_id)4. API EndpointsAuthPOST /auth/register: {email, password} -> {id, email}POST /auth/login: {email, password} -> {token}Diary (Auth Required)POST /diaries: {title?, content, mood?, tags?: string[]}GET /diaries: List all entries (simple list)GET /diaries/:id: Get specific entry with tagsPATCH /diaries/:id: Update fields. If tags provided, replace all existing tag relations.DELETE /diaries/:id: Delete entry and associated diary_tags.Timeline (Auth Required)GET /timeline?tag=...&mood=...&limit=20&offset=0Returns entries ordered by created_at DESC.5. File Structuresrc/app.ts: Hono app entry point and route registration.src/db/connection.ts: Database initialization and connection export.src/db/schema.ts: SQL constants for table creation.src/auth/service.ts: Logic for user registration, password hashing, and session management.src/auth/routes.ts: Auth HTTP handlers.src/diary/service.ts: CRUD logic for diaries and tags.src/diary/routes.ts: Diary HTTP handlers.src/timeline/routes.ts: Timeline HTTP handlers.test/auth.test.ts: Auth tests.test/diary.test.ts: Diary and timeline tests.6. Acceptance Criteria[ ] Password hashes are stored, not plain text.[ ] Unauthorized requests (missing/invalid Bearer token) return 401.[ ] Users cannot access or modify diaries belonging to other users.[ ] Tags are deduplicated per user (case-insensitive).[ ] Deleting a diary removes its entries in diary_tags.[ ] updated_at is updated on PATCH.[ ] /timeline correctly filters by tag and mood.[ ] bunx tsc --noEmit passes.[ ] bun test passes all scenarios.Auto-Assumed ClarificationsHow exactly should tags be deduplicated?Assumption: Tags are case-insensitive and stored as lowercase in normalized_name. When a user provides tags, they are checked against existing normalized_name for that user.
